title: Add the MCP server to vibe coder and test each tool
vibe_coder: Claude Code (Claude desktop app, Code tab)
how_tested: Claude Code loaded campus-customs from .mcp.json, and each tool was called through that MCP connection (mcp__campus-customs__<tool>). Each output below is copied exactly as the tool returned it, then checked with a direct SQL query against data/campus_customs_new.db.
user_request: Test each of the five MCP tools I have. Save the evidence in output/mcp_smoke.json . For every tool include the prompt that was asked, the tool name, and the tool output (which much match the values in data/campus_customs_new.db)
prompt_note: The per-tool prompts below are the test questions the vibe coder answered for my request above, one per tool, each tied to an open ticket. I reviewed each test prompt, understand how it works, and kept them; all five tools behaved as expected.
database_note: These outputs were recorded on 2026-11-01, when data/campus_customs_new.db was still an exact copy of the original data/campus_customs.db. They match the original database exactly. Problem 9 then resolved the tickets in the working copy, which changed two of these values there (see recheck_2026_11_02).

recheck_2026_11_02.how: Each tool was called again through the same MCP server, read-only, against both database files.

against_data/campus_customs_new.db (work.get_lease: next_due is now 2026-10-02 (was 2026-09-02), days_until_due 32 (was 2), because the $2,400 rent for lease 1 was paid in Problem 9 and the lease moved to its next due date
against_data/campus_customs_new.db (work.get_ticket_urgency: ticket 101 is now resolved (urgency not_open, no deadline), because invoice 501 was paid in Problem 9

recheck_2026_11_02.tool_change_after_review: After a final review, get_vendor_lead_time also reports whether a vendor is on hold: a vendor ships nothing new while it has an unpaid invoice. Run against the original database today, it adds on_hold: true for Bulldog Print Co (invoice 501 unpaid) and gives the arrival as '5 days after invoice 501 is paid' instead of 2026-09-05. The vendor, lead days and specialty above are unchanged.

tests.prompt: Ticket 101: Tauhid Zaman wants a Classic Bulldog Tee in size S. Is CC-TEE-WHITE in stock in size S?

db_check.query: SELECT size, qty, name, location FROM inventory WHERE sku = 'CC-TEE-WHITE'

tests.answer: No. The shop has 0 Classic Bulldog Tees in size S (Aisle B), so ticket 101 cannot be filled from stock; M has 5, L 3, XL 2.

tests.prompt: Ticket 102: Elm City Properties emailed that rent is due in 2 days. What does lease 1 say we owe and when?

db_check.query: SELECT space_name, landlord, monthly_rent, next_due, notes FROM leases WHERE id = 1; SELECT date_today FROM desk

tests.answer: The lease confirms the notice: $2,400 for the Chapel Street shop is owed to Elm City Properties on 2026-09-02, 2 days after the shop's date of 2026-08-31.

tests.prompt: Ticket 103: The Yale AI Club wants a bulk discount on navy hoodies. What are the list price and unit cost for CC-HOOD-NAVY?

db_check.query: SELECT list_price, unit_cost FROM pricing WHERE sku = 'CC-HOOD-NAVY'

tests.answer: List price is $58 and unit cost is $22 ($36 margin each), so 20 hoodies are $1,160 at list and any discount must stay above $440.

db_check.query: SELECT t.type, t.subject, t.status, t.created_at, t.invoice_id, i.due_date, i.status FROM tickets t JOIN invoices i ON i.id = t.invoice_id WHERE t.id = 101; SELECT date_today FROM desk
db_check.note: 2026-08-28 is 3 days before 2026-08-31, so days_until_deadline = -3 and the rule gives overdue.

tests.answer: Overdue. Ticket 101 links to open invoice 501 (the rush reprint of this tee), which was due 2026-08-28, 3 days before the shop's date.

tests.prompt: Ticket 103 needs more hoodies than we have. Which vendor reprints apparel, and when could a new order arrive?

db_check.query: SELECT id, name, specialty, lead_days FROM vendors WHERE specialty LIKE '%apparel%'; SELECT date_today FROM desk

tests.answer: Bulldog Print Co reprints apparel with a 5-day lead time, so hoodies ordered on 2026-08-31 could arrive 2026-09-05 at the earliest.
